name: C#

requires.installHint: Install the .NET 10 SDK or newer from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download

runnerHint: Install the .NET 10 SDK or newer from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download

levelHints.Beginner: new to C# or to professional development: core syntax, collections, LINQ basics, async basics.
levelHints.Intermediate: comfortable day to day: sharper idioms, concurrency with async, generics, pattern matching.
levelHints.Advanced: design trade-offs, performance, concurrency control, API design.
levelHints.Expert: deep language and runtime topics: `Span<T>`, `ValueTask`, source generators, allocation-free code.
